content: Dependency for DcmDspDataResetToDefaultFnc DcmDspDataResetToDefaultFnc shall be only present if: • DcmDspDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_SYNCH_FNC or • DcmDspDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_ASYNCH_FNC or • DcmDspDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_ASYNCH_FNC_ERROR

Dependency for DcmDspDataResetToDefaultFnc DcmDspDataResetToDefaultFnc shall be only present if: • DcmDspDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_SYNCH_FNC or • DcmDspDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_ASYNCH_FNC or • DcmDspDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_ASYNCH_FNC_ERROR
